name: Get Sample VTIs
description: Get the VMRay Threat Identifiers (VTIs) of a sample, optionally only the high-scoring ones — costs no quota.

sample_id.description: VMRay sample ID — e.g. the `sample_ids` of Get Submission Result or Get Samples By Hash.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

submission_id.description: VMRay submission ID — e.g. the `submission_ids` of Get Submission Result. It is resolved to its sample with one GET /submission/{id}. Used when `sample_id` is empty.
submission_id.title: Submission ID

min_score.description: Only return the threat identifiers whose score is at least this (VMRay scores them 1 to 5). 0 returns every identifier.
min_score.title: Minimum score

found.description: True when at least one VMRay Threat Identifier is returned.
found.title: Found

sample_id.description: The sample the data belongs to.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

vti_count.description: How many threat identifiers are returned (after `min_score`).
vti_count.title: VTI count

max_score.description: The highest score among the returned identifiers.
max_score.title: Max Score

threat_indicators.description: The VMRay Threat Identifiers exactly as VMRay returns them.
threat_indicators.title: Threat Indicators
